title: release-engineering-meeting-notes-2026-06-23
content:
Meeting: Release Engineering - Weekly sync
Date: 2026-06-23
Time: 10:00 - 10:45 UTC
Location: #release-eng weekly / Zoom
Facilitator: Aisha Malik
Note-taker: Jonah Park

Attendees:
- Aisha Malik (release eng)
- Jonah Park (release eng)
- Mei Chen (serving-runtime)
- Luis Garcia (platform infra)
- Samir Patel (SRE)
- Guests: Priya Rao (product-hosted-api, 10:15-10:30)

Agenda:
1) Quick status: current release train and open hotfixes
2) Hotfix INC-4321 (tokenization edge-case causing hosted API crashes)
3) Changelog items for 2026.06.3 and tagging/release notes owners
4) Canary plan and rollout schedule for model-serving runtime update
5) Post-deploy monitoring and rollback triggers
6) Action items and next steps

Notes / Discussion:
1) Release train status
- Current train: 2026.06.3 (minor patch train focused on reliability fixes). Cut window target: 2026-06-24 02:00 UTC.
- Candidate change list is stable as of this morning; main commits include:
  - api: fix intermittent tokenization crash (PR 345)
  - runtime: improved kv-cache eviction heuristics
  - infra: increase canary pool size to 3 nodes for dedicated clusters
- Branch: release/2026.06.3 is open. QA smoke tests passing in CI (green for 22/24 checks). Two flaky tests left (see linked PRs).

2) Hotfix INC-4321 (high priority)
- Symptom: Hosted API requests with very long concatenated prompts occasionally hit a tokenization path that throws and causes runtime worker to crash (observed increase in 500s for specific customer workloads).
- Impact: ~0.5% of requests in the last 24h for hosted tier, customer-reported incidents (priority P2).
- Root cause: edge-case in tokenizer when handling adjacent control characters + whitespace in concat flow. Repro on dev with fuzzed prompts.
- Proposed fix: PR 345 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/345) - small tokenizer guard + additional unit tests.
- Deployment plan: include PR345 in release 2026.06.3 and perform an out-of-band hotfix rollout for hosted API if tests pass earlier.
- Hotfix window (if out-of-band): 2026-06-24 02:00 - 03:00 UTC. Targeted hosted backend only (no changes to dedicated/private).
- Rollback: rollback tag 2026.06.3-hotfix -> re-deploy previous worker image; SRE to initiate and notify customers.

3) Changelog and release notes
- Changelog draft created in Confluence (confluence:release-train-2026-06).
- Owners: Priya Rao for hosted-api notes; Mei Chen for runtime notes; Jonah Park for infra/deploy notes.
- Items to include: tokenization hotfix (INC-4321), kv-cache eviction improvement, canary pool sizing change, minor logging cleanup.
- Release notes target: publish internal changelog + external short announcement on status.redwood.ai post-deploy.

4) Canary plan / rollout schedule
- Canary plan for runtime update (includes PR345 and kv-cache change):
  - Stage 1 (canary): 5% traffic, 30 minutes monitoring window
  - Stage 2: 25% traffic, 60 minutes window
  - Stage 3: 100% traffic, 2-hour monitoring window
- For hosted API we will route by customer segments; do not include enterprise customers pinned to dedicated capacity in canary.
- Automation: use rollout automation in console to increment traffic with manual approvals at each stage. If automation fails, SRE to perform manual cutover.

5) Monitoring and rollback triggers
- Primary metrics to watch (SLO-aware):
  - 5xx rate (target <0.1%); rollback trigger at >0.5% sustained for 10m
  - p95 latency (token-gen path) - rollback if >2x baseline for 10m
  - error budget burn (automated alert if 24h burn > 75%)
  - Token throughput and CPU/GPU utilization on canary nodes
- Synthetic smoke tests: verify sample prompts (including fuzzed control-character cases) immediately post-deploy.
- Alerting: create temporary channel #release-rollouts-2026-06-24 and add on-call SRE + release eng.

6) Dependencies / blocking items
- QA: two flaky tests noted; Jonah to triage and either quarantine or fix before cut. (Blocked test IDs: CI-qt-12, CI-smoke-04)
- Legal/Compliance: no schema/data changes; no sign-off required for this minor patch.
- Infra quotas: Luis confirmed extra canary capacity reserved in us-west-2 for 06-24 window.

Decisions made:
- Include PR345 in release 2026.06.3 and proceed with targeted canary rollout as described.
- If canary shows >0.5% 5xx for 10m, immediately roll back to previous image and open incident.
- Release notes authors assigned (see above).

Action items (owner - due):
- Jonah Park - triage flaky CI tests, quarantine failing tests if not fixed (due 2026-06-23 EOD).
- Mei Chen - validate fuzzed prompt smoke test suite and add additional cases for control-character combos (due 2026-06-23 18:00 UTC).
- Luis Garcia - finalize canary capacity reservations and validate autoscaler settings for canary pool (due 2026-06-23 20:00 UTC).
- Samir Patel - create #release-rollouts-2026-06-24 channel and set up alert routing for SRE on-call (due 2026-06-23 18:00 UTC).
- Priya Rao - draft hosted-api release notes and external blurb for status.redwood.ai (due 2026-06-24 09:00 UTC).

Risks / Mitigations:
- Risk: Flaky tests delaying cut. Mitigation: quarantine flakies and proceed with additional manual smoke validations.
- Risk: Canary insufficient to detect rare tokenization crash. Mitigation: expand canary test set to include customer-specific prompt corpus (permission required; Mei to follow up).
- Risk: Rollout automation failure. Mitigation: manual rollback/runbooks ready; Samir to confirm runbook links in channel.

Changelog snippet (to be included in release notes):
- Fix: hosted API tokenization edge-case causing intermittent 500s (INC-4321, PR 345)
- Improvement: KV-cache eviction heuristics reduced memory spikes under high-concurrency
- Ops: increased canary pool size for dedicated clusters to improve canary signal
- Misc: logging cleanup and test coverage improvements

Next meeting:
- Weekly sync: 2026-06-30 10:00 UTC
- Additional dry-run post-cut retrospective: 2026-06-24 14:00 UTC (optional, attendees: release eng + SRE + QA)

Notes & links:
- Jira: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RE-5678 (release epic)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/345
- Confluence draft: confluence:release-train-2026-06
- Incident: INC-4321

Meeting adjourned: 10:44 UTC
